subject: C31
performed_by: Claude Code driving the real fixture window through macOS Accessibility (System Events and the ax helper) with fixture WebView self-capture; tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c31.py

checks.description: Administration renders the core's inventory: Agentic Identity and Endpoint Security show their gate and nothing else; each tab offers exactly its admitted actions with per-tab labels (Custom topics 'New topic…', API keys 'New API key…', no 'New application…', an API key's 'Issue additional key…', 'Regenerate…' and 'Remove…' but never 'Edit…'); the Gateway tabs omit the removed Limits tab and its keys never offer 'Issue additional key…' or 'Finish rotation…'; Codebase scans is unavailable with its gate.
checks.observation: AIS/AES gates True; New topic… True; no New application… True; New API key… True; key actions ['Issue additional key…', 'Regenerate…', 'Remove…']; Gateway tabs ['Overview', 'Playground', 'Security profiles', 'Custom topics', 'Applications', 'API keys', 'DLP', 'Deployment profiles', 'Overview', 'Workspaces', 'Routes', 'Providers', 'Guardrails', 'Keys', 'Integrations', 'Logs', 'MCP servers', 'Team A', 'Team B']; Gateway keys never offer a version False; Codebase scans unavailable True

checks.description: A custom topic edit opens the review sheet; Apply stays disabled until the typed name matches exactly (empty and wrong case refused); Apply opens the native confirmation titled for the topic; Return applies once; the applied panel says 'Live. The item was read back.'; Done closes the sheet.
checks.observation: review sheet True; Apply disabled empty True and wrong-case True, enabled on the exact name True; native confirmation True titled for Finance True; applied panel 'Live. The item was read back.' True; PUT writes 1; Done closed True

checks.description: The staged Runtime key rotation: 'Issue additional key…' reviewed with CREATE and confirmed natively issues one key and shows 'Additional key issued · old key still active'; Reveal opens the host secret sheet with the issued key (never in the web view); Escape ends the review; the Inbox lists the distinct reminder; 'Finish rotation…' resumes without any secret control; 'Application updated' records the local acknowledgement and opens the old key's removal review; its native Delete removes the key once and the panel reads 'Rotation complete · old key removed' with both labelled timestamps.
checks.observation: additional key issued True with one POST True; Reveal opened the host sheet True showing the issued key True; Escape closed True; Inbox reminder True; Finish rotation… resumed True with no Reveal True; Application updated acknowledged True; old key removed through its review with one DELETE True → complete True; both labelled timestamps True

checks.description: The accessibility additions (DESIGN-V2 §8) on the changed UI: the review sheet is the one topmost modal (the rail hidden beneath it) and Escape closes it with focus returned to the page; the rotation reminder leaves the Inbox once the old key is read back gone; Tab from a product header reaches its tabs; at the 900×600 minimum and 200% zoom in both themes nothing on the Administration screen lies past the window's right edge; a focused review-sheet control shows its focus ring (pixels around it change against the unfocused capture); the applied result and the rotation's completion sit in polite status regions; with Reduce Motion on, the applied change's toast stays past 6 s until dismissed, and the system setting is restored.
checks.observation: rotation sheet topmost (rail hidden) True; Escape closed True returning focus to 'Administration' (True); reminder cleared after completion True; Tab from the Runtime header reached its tabs False; at 900×600 and 200% overflow light 0 px, dark 0 px; focus ring on the review sheet's Close 496 px changed (True); applied result in a status region True; rotation completion announced in the panel's status region True; Reduce Motion active True: the applied toast shown True, still present after 8 s True, dismissed True, setting restored True

limitations: Pixels come from the fixture build's own WKWebView snapshot; the native confirmation and secret sheets are verified through the accessibility tree.
Changes run against the synthetic management endpoint (tools/native-acceptance/mgmt_server.py); the live topic review row is recorded separately under evidence/C31/live.
